dePollLoop()
739:             val old=webSocket
740:             webSocket=null
741:             _connectionState.value=false
742:             controlRetries.cancel()
743:             old?.cancel()
744:             _connectionStatus.value=if(serverUrl.isBlank() || authCookie.isBlank()) ConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED else ConnectionStatus.CONNECTING
745:             controlRetries.request(true)
746:         }
747:     }
748: 
749:     fun disconnect() {
750:         controlGeneration.locked {
751:             isUserLogout=true
752:             controlConnecting=false
753:             controlGeneration.advance()
754:             controlTimeout?.cancel()
755:             controlTimeout=null
756:             controlRetries.cancel()
757:             cancelControlWork()
758:             stopPingLoop()
759:             stopNodePollLoop()
760:             val old=webSocket
761:             webSocket=null
762:             old?.cancel()
763:             _connectionState.value=false
764:             _connectionStatus.value=ConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED
765: 
766:         isUserLogout = true
767:         controlRetries.cancel()
768:         stopPingLoop()
769:         stopNodePollLoop()
770:         webSocket?.close(1000, "User logout")
771:         webSocket = null
772:         _connectionStatus.value = ConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED
773:         _connectionState.value = false
774:         meshesMap.clear()
775:         nodesMap.clear()
776:         _groupedDevices.value = emptyList()
777: 
778:         }
779:     }
780:     private fun cancelControlWork() {
781:         val jobs=controlWork.toList()
782:         controlWork.clear()
783:         jobs.forEach { it.cancel() }
784:     }
785: 
786:     private fun launchControlWork(block:suspend CoroutineScope.(WebSocket?)->Unit):Job = controlGeneration.locked {
787:         val epoch=controlGeneration.current()
788:         val captured=webSocket
789:         val job=scope.launch(start=CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
790:             val valid=controlGeneration.locked {
791:                 captured!=null && controlGeneration.current()==epoch && webSocket===captured && !isUserLogout
792:             }
793:             if(valid) block(this,captured)
794:         }
795:         controlWork.add(job)
796:         job.invokeOnCompletion { controlGeneration.locked { controlWork.remove(job) } }
797:         job.start()
798:         job
799:     }
800: 
801:     private fun retireControlSocket(epoch:Long,socket:WebSocket):Boolean = controlGeneration.locked {
802:         if(controlGeneration.current()!=epoch || webSocket!==socket) return@locked false
803:         controlGeneration.advance()
804:         controlConnecting=false
805:         webSocket=null
806:         controlTimeout?.cancel()
807:         controlTimeout=null
808:         cancelControlWork()
809:         stopPingLoop()
810:         stopNodePollLoop()
811:         _connectionState.value=false
812:         _connectionStatus.value=if(isUserLogout) ConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED else ConnectionStatus.CONNECTING
813:         if(!isUserLogout) controlRetries.request()
814:         true
815:     }
816: 
817: }
